title: Nails
simplified_paragraphs: 有一个男孩常常对别人乱发脾气。一天，他的父亲告诉他:"你每次发脾气的时候，就在后院的围墙上钉一根钉子。”
第一天，这个男孩钉了37根钉子。后来，男孩觉得控制自己的脾气比钉钉子要容易一些，所以他每天发脾气的次数就逐渐减少了。终于有一天，这个男孩能控制住自己的情绪了。
父亲又告诉他:"从现在开始，每次你控制住不发脾气的时候，就拔出一根钉子。”过了很久，男孩终于把所有的钉子都拔了出来。
父亲对男孩说：”孩子，你做得很好。但是你看这围墙上的小洞，他们将永远存在。围墙再也不能恢复到从前的样子了。所以你要时刻记住，不要随便把钉子钉进别人的心里。
traditional_paragraphs: 有一個男孩常常對別人亂發脾氣。一天，他的父親告訴他:"你每次發脾氣的時候，就在後院的圍牆上釘一根釘子。”
第一天，這個男孩釘了37根釘子。後來，男孩覺得控制自己的脾氣比釘釘子要容易一些，所以他每天發脾氣的次數就逐漸減少了。終於有一天，這個男孩能控制住自己的情緒了。
父親又告訴他:"從現在開始，每次你控制住不發脾氣的時候，就拔出一根釘子。”過了很久，男孩終於把所有的釘子都拔了出來。
父親對男孩說：”孩子，你做得很好。但是你看這圍牆上的小洞，他們將永遠存在。圍牆再也不能恢復到從前的樣子了。所以你要時刻記住，不要隨便把釘子釘進別人的心裡。
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu yī gè nán hái cháng cháng duì bié rén luàn fā pí qì。 yī tiān， tā de fù qīn gào su tā :" nǐ měi cì fā pí qì de shí hou， jiù zài hòu yuàn de wéi qiáng shàng dìng yī gēn dīng zi。”

dì yī tiān， zhè gè nán hái dìng le 37 gēn dīng zi。 hòu lái， nán hái jué de kòng zhì zì jǐ de pí qi bǐ dìng dīng zi yào róng yì yī xiē， suǒ yǐ tā měi tiān fā pí qì de cì shù jiù zhú jiàn jiǎn shǎo le。 zhōng yú yǒu yī tiān， zhè gè nán hái néng kòng zhì zhù zì jǐ de qíng xù le。
fù qīn yòu gào su tā :" cóng xiàn zài kāi shǐ， měi cì nǐ kòng zhì zhù bù fā pí qì de shí hou， jiù bá chū yī gēn dīng zi。” guò le hěn jiǔ， nán hái zhōng yú bǎ suǒ yǒu de dīng zi dōu bá le chu lai。

fù qīn duì nán hái shuō：” hái zi， nǐ zuò de hěn hǎo。 dàn shì nǐ kàn zhè wéi qiáng shàng de xiǎo dòng， tā men jiāng yǒng yuǎn cún zài。 wéi qiáng zài yě bù néng huī fù dào cóng qián de yàng zi le。 suǒ yǐ nǐ yào shí kè jì zhu， bù yào suí biàn bǎ dīng zi dìng jìn bié rén de xīn lǐ。
english_paragraphs: There was once a boy who often lost his temper with other people. One day, his father told him, “Every time you lose your temper, hammer a nail into the wall around the backyard.”

On the first day, the boy hammered in 37 nails. Later, he found that controlling his temper was easier than hammering in nails, so he gradually lost his temper less and less often. At last, one day, he was able to control his emotions.
His father then told him, “From now on, every time you manage not to lose your temper, pull out a nail.” After a long time, the boy finally pulled out all the nails.

His father said, “Son, you’ve done well. But look at the little holes in this wall. They will always be there. The wall can never be the way it was before. So always remember: don’t carelessly drive nails into other people’s hearts.”
english_full:
There was once a boy who often lost his temper with other people. One day, his father told him, “Every time you lose your temper, hammer a nail into the wall around the backyard.”

On the first day, the boy hammered in 37 nails. Later, he found that controlling his temper was easier than hammering in nails, so he gradually lost his temper less and less often. At last, one day, he was able to control his emotions.

His father then told him, “From now on, every time you manage not to lose your temper, pull out a nail.” After a long time, the boy finally pulled out all the nails.

His father said, “Son, you’ve done well. But look at the little holes in this wall. They will always be there. The wall can never be the way it was before. So always remember: don’t carelessly drive nails into other people’s hearts.”
